definitions.explanation: Moving from one school to another, typically due to a family relocation. Used for elementary, middle, and high school students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{転校|てんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I ended up transferring schools due to my father's job transfer.

examples.japanese: {転校|てんこう}⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was nervous on my first day at the new school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転校生|てんこうせい}→転校生：19652_tenkousei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦{転校生|てんこうせい}→転校生：19652_tenkousei⟧ = transfer student

notes:
USAGE: {転校|てんこう} specifically refers to changing schools at the elementary, middle, or high school level. For university, use ⟦{転学|てんがく}→転学：noentry⟧ or ⟦{編入|へんにゅう}→編入：13887_hennyuu⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {転校|てんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to transfer schools)
- {転校|てんこう}⟦{届|とどけ}→届け：07558_todoke⟧ (school transfer notification)
- {転校|てんこう}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (transfer procedures)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{転校生|てんこうせい}→転校生：19652_tenkousei⟧ (transfer student)
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧ (job transfer - often the reason for {転校|てんこう})
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧ (moving house)
- ⟦{編入|へんにゅう}→編入：13887_hennyuu⟧ (transfer admission - for universities)
- ⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧ (dropping out)

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, transferring schools mid-year is relatively common due to company job transfers. Transfer students are a common theme in anime and manga.
